item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Tinubu declared a nationwide state of emergency, imposed a broad emergency regime, or publicly launched a sweeping surveillance program. I also did not find strong evidence of a transparent, independent review process for security-force abuse before the November minors probe and release order. The main pattern in 2024 was ordinary-law coercion: protest policing, treason charges, and cybercrime enforcement used in ways rights groups said chilled dissent.","evidence":[{"title":"We Will Transform Nigeria Police Into Modern, Professional Force - President Tinubu","publisher":"State House","date":"April 16, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/we-will-transform-nigeria-police-into-modern-professional-force-president-tinubu/","summary":"Tinubu said his administration was making the police more modern, professional, accountable, and better trained. This is the clearest policy-level signal for narrower, lawful security governance.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.4","3B.2"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Appoints New Leadership for Police Service Commission and Nigerian Police Trust Fund","publisher":"State House","date":"June 10, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-appoints-new-leadership-for-police-service-commission-and-nigerian-police-trust-fund/","summary":"New PSC and Trust Fund leadership supports civilian oversight capacity over policing, though the release does not describe a complaint system or abuse-investigation mechanism.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.4","3B.2"]},{"title":"Tinubu orders probe of security agents involved in arrest, detention of minors","publisher":"TheCable","date":"November 4, 2024","url":"https://www.thecable.ng/tinubu-orders-probe-of-security-agents-involved-in-arrest-detention-of-minors/","summary":"Tinubu ordered a probe into the arrest, detention, and treatment of minors detained over protests and said involved officers would be investigated and disciplined if needed. This is indirect, but it points toward intimidation rather than neutral administration.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.3","3B.2"]},{"title":"Nigeria security forces deploy, government offers dialogue as protests loom","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"July 31, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/nigeria-security-forces-deploy-government-offers-dialogue-as-protests-loom-3546462","summary":"The government said it was open to dialogue, but security forces were simultaneously deployed in major cities. Mixed on its face, but the coercive preparedness undercuts the claim of narrowly lawful restraint.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.2"]}]}
